parameters_used_by_the_relay.level: enum {ad, adset, campaign, account}; the relay asks for campaign
parameters_used_by_the_relay.time_increment: an integer from 1 to 90 gives one result set per N days; the relay asks for 1; ignored if time_ranges is given
parameters_used_by_the_relay.time_range: a single time range object {since, until}; UNIX timestamps are not supported
parameters_used_by_the_relay.fields: campaign_id, campaign_name, spend, impressions, clicks, account_currency

field_types.spend: numeric string; the estimated total amount of money spent
field_types.impressions: numeric string in the page's example response
field_types.clicks: numeric string in the page's example response
field_types.account_currency: string; Currency that is used by your ad account
field_types.date_start: present on every row; date_stop closes the bucket

refresh: Insights refresh every 15 minutes and do not change after 28 days of being reported
not_stated: that spend is in account_currency (the likely reading, ASSUMED)
